name: simple-memory
description: A local markdown knowledge base with keyword hints on every prompt, note tools, and a band of suggested and read notes.

directory.title: Memory directory
directory.description: Where the notes live. Absolute, ~/..., or relative to the project directory.

maxHints.title: Hints per prompt
maxHints.description: The most notes suggested for one prompt.

recentNotes.title: Recent notes at session start
recentNotes.description: How many recently updated notes are listed in the session's opening context.

extraStopwords.title: Extra stopwords
extraStopwords.description: Comma- or space-separated words never used as keywords (for example words of another language).
